description:
Full CliniAtlas answer to a clinical or research question, with numbered citations.

        Searches the literature, guidelines and EMA documents and writes a cited answer, the
        same answer cliniatlas.com gives. Uncited parts are reported through grounding.
        Check search_evidence_library first; when a published answer matches, use that
        instead, because each call here uses one of the user's free daily answers (see
        free_answers_remaining_today). Usually takes 35 to 50 seconds: if status is
        "running", call get_cliniatlas_answer with job_id. Do not include patient
        identifiers. For literature research and education, not individual care decisions.
name: ask_cliniatlas
title: Ask CliniAtlas
